thread:
jess_cs: Heads-up: Retcon account dedicated bring-up rehearsal scheduled Mon 2026-06-14 09:00 PT. Scope: quota gating, autoscale behavior, and two short load passes. Need infra and oncall owners.
omar_infra: I can drive infra. Reserved pool is 4xH100, customer requested burst to 8 for short peaks. Confirmed burst billing applies and requires customer opt-in.
jess_cs: Good. Please ensure burst billing knob is documented and we notify finance. Also capture per-token labels in metrics.
pierre_sre: Autoscale proposal: min_instances=2, max_instances=8, scale_metric=avg_gpu_usage, target=0.68, cooldown=180s. Add max_scale_step=1 to avoid overshoot.
lilly_oncall: I'll own monitoring during the window. Watchlist: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, queue_depth, avg_gpu_util, kv_hit_rate. Take pager if p99 errors >1% sustained for 3m. Ping me 8m prior.
omar_infra: Load plan: canary 6m at 15 RPS, ramp 12m to 320 RPS, sustain 6m, then a 2m spike @480 RPS. Scripts: s3://redwood-loads/retcon/2026-06-13/retcon-loads-v1.tar.gz. Example: `k6 run --vus 350 --duration 26m chat_scenario.js`.
jess_cs: Include KV/prefix priming (customer uses multi-turn, long contexts). Also ask product which prefixes to seed.
pierre_sre: We'll run a 120-session priming job 25m before canary and enable prefix_cache on the route. Also add a quick eval comparing reserved vs hosted fallback latencies.
omar_infra: Draft autoscale snippet (to PR):
```
min_instances: 2
max_instances: 8
scale_metric: avg_gpu_usage
target: 0.68
cooldown_seconds: 180
max_scale_step: 1
burst_policy: auto
```
PR: https://git.internal/infra/retcon-autoscale/pull/9 (assigning @pierre_sre)
jess_cs: Add safety gating: if reserved consumption >87% for 7m, pause new onramps and route non-critical traffic to hosted fallback. Alert #ops-oncall and cc the customer SRE.
alert_bot: Notice: runbook updated 'dedicated-onramp' section 4.1 - burst enrollment and safety gating. Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-onramp#safety-gates
lilly_oncall: Fallback: route to hosted-v2.0 with feature degrade (no streaming) if latency or errors breach. I'll prepare the failover play and test it in staging beforehand.
omar_infra: Will add request tags: account=retcon-prod, route=dedicated-v1, to help cost attribution. Also export token labels to the metrics pipeline for finance reconciliation.
jess_cs: Customer enablement: I'll schedule a 30m prep call Friday to walk their SRE through expected behaviors and the failover. If utilization >75% for 48h after run, loop in renewals.
pierre_sre: I'll wire tracing headers to measure kv_hit_rate and response tails. Also add a temporary debug endpoint for sampling.
omar_infra: Aim to merge infra PR by EOD Sun to let config stabilize. Tagging @jess_cs when merged.
jess_cs: Thanks team. Please post short post-run notes including cost delta and any anomalies. I'll update the customer-facing checklist once PR merges.
